The continuous loop renders the current pose and fixed creature coordinates, then schedules another redraw; it does not advance task state.
Simplified mode maps the labelled buttons to synchronous movement, turning, and firing functions.
The visible LIVE and recoil effects are CSS animation/presentation effects, not task-state updates.
The grader replays the submitted synchronous transcript, validates monotone timestamps, and computes movement and shot outcomes from the fixed manifest.
The normal solver follows a precomputed route and fires through the selected input surface; it does not wait for or track autonomous creature motion.
